title: Past Life Memories
next_chapter_hook: When the golden light flooded Chen Ji's mind with images of ten thousand lifetimes, he saw his ancient self—that being who once ruled the Heavenly Realm, being dismembered inch by inch by an invisible cosmic will.

text.content: The golden light surged into Chen Ji's consciousness like a flood, and the gears of fate shattered completely at this moment. His Mental Sea felt as if torn open, with countless scenes flickering past like a kaleidoscope—seven thousand years of reincarnation, seven thousand deaths and rebirths, each time searching for something, yet always falling before reaching the end. 'Is this... everything of mine?' Chen Ji's voice echoed through his Mental Sea, trembling with undisguised emotion.

The scene froze abruptly. The ruins of Tianqing Sect vanished, replaced by a towering white jade palace that seemed to have no end. Stars hung like jeweled pendants from above, while sun and moon floated like lanterns on either side. That was the Heavenly Realm—the eternal彼岸 that mortals spoke of, the forbidden land that countless cultivators could never reach even after lifetimes of pursuit. And in the deepest part of that palace, a figure stood with hands clasped behind, gazing down upon all living things.

dialogue.content: 'That is you—or rather, that is your original form.' The voice of the Fate Scribe came from all directions. 'The first wielder of the Tianji Record, the Co-Lord of the Heavenly Realm, the creator of the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. You used your own body as kindling, burning your divine soul to create that eye that observes all things, thus grasping fate in the palm of your hand.'

text.content: Chen Ji stared at that figure, his heart feeling as if gripped by an invisible hand. He recognized that face—sword-shaped brows, star-like eyes, lips slightly curled, carrying three parts of indifference and seven parts of arrogance. It was clearly his own face, yet many times younger than his current appearance, with sharp vigor that overlooked all beneath heaven. 'I... am the Co-Lord of the Heavenly Realm?' His voice was hoarse, as if even he couldn't believe it.

The scene shifted. That figure sat before the Tianji Record, fingertips gently touching it. Countless golden runes flew from the pages, weaving into a great net covering the three realms. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets—that eye was not some external object, but a third eye slowly opening from his Brow Center. Its pupil reflected the fates of all living beings. At that time, he was the true Chess Player, the supreme being who manipulated heaven's way between his fingers.

dialogue.content: 'You were too powerful, powerful enough to make Heaven's Way itself grow fearful.' The Fate Scribe's voice suddenly dropped low. 'It could not allow any existence to surpass its own will. So it set a trap—one that made you personally剥离, seal, and then forget the Eye of Heavenly Secrets. You thought it was your own choice, but from the beginning, you were already written into fate's chess game.'

text.content: The scene changed dramatically once more. Chen Ji witnessed that cataclysmic upheaval—the Heavenly Realm collapsed, sun and moon reversed, countless celestials turned to ash amid wails. And his original self was being entangled by countless rays of black light, those rays coming from all directions, from Heaven's Way itself, from the Eye of Heavenly Secrets he had created. His divine soul was torn apart inch by inch, and blood dyed the entire palace crimson.

'No—' Chen Ji下意识reached out, but could only watch as that figure disintegrated into fragments amid the interweaving golden light and black mist. His memories rushed forth like a breached dam: the fury of betrayal, the agony of dismemberment, the despair of sealing. Those were not his experiences, yet they felt more real than any personal experience. The answer to seven thousand years of reincarnation was found in this moment—he was not searching for anything, but atoning, repaying that which Heaven's Way had stolen from him entirely.

dialogue.content: 'You think the Eye of Heavenly Secrets is your creation? No, it is Heaven's Way's eye, merely using your soul as its vessel.' The Fate Scribe's voice carried a hint of mockery. 'From the first moment you created it, you were destined to become its puppet. Seven thousand lifetimes of reincarnation, every time the Tianji Record appeared, it was harvesting your Heavenly Fate Value—and you, were utterly unaware.'

text.content: Chen Ji raised his head sharply, his eyes no longer holding the shock from before, replaced by a chill that seeped into his marrow. His fists slowly clenched, knuckles white from tension. 'So... my scheming across the world, my flawless strategies, were merely a joke in its eyes?' His voice was very soft, as if挤出 between his teeth, each word carrying bone-deep hatred. 'I thought I was the Chess Player, when from start to finish, I was merely the most insignificant piece on the board.'

The golden light began to dissipate, those memories of ten thousand lifetimes receded like a tide, leaving only endless void and silence. Chen Ji stood in place, spine straight as a rod, yet his clenched fists trembled slightly. He was no longer thattrashdisciple, no longer that schemer who hid his true strength to devour others—he was the Co-Lord of the Heavenly Realm betrayed by Heaven's Way, the ancient being dismembered by his own creation. Seven thousand years of hatred condensed at this moment into rage sufficient to incinerate the heavens.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, allowing that primordial power to surge through his body. Deep within his Mental Sea, the three seals on the Eye of Heavenly Secrets began to loosen, golden light emerging from his Brow Center, piercing through the surrounding darkness. 'Since I am its creator,' his voice was low and resolute, 'then let me end this ten thousand lifetimes of deception.'

As the golden light blazed brilliantly, a crack opened in Chen Ji's Brow Center, and that Eye of Heavenly Secrets that had slumbered for ten thousand years slowly opened. What reflected in its pupil was no longer mortal fates, but the causes and effects of the entire universe—the本体 of Heavenly Way's will, exposed nakedly before his vision for the first time.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the turmoil in his Mental Sea. Those visions, those memories, those bone-deep hatred—he chose to seal them away temporarily. "The me from ten thousand worlds ago is already dead," he murmured to himself, his voice regaining its usual calmness. "The me now is only Chen Ji."

The golden light faded, and the Mental Sea returned to silence. Chen Ji opened his eyes, finding himself still standing in the same spot, as if everything just now had been nothing more than an illusory dream. But the lingering warmth at his brow center told him—it was not a dream; he simply chose not to face it. Thetrash disciple of Tianqing Sect must continue his path of feigning weakness to devour tigers.

text.content: "The third path." A sharp light flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. "Since you say the final task of Chen Tianming needs to be completed, then tell me—what exactly is this task? Since I am the seventh Chess Player, since the Heavenly Secrets Eye shares the same origin, does the third path mean I have a chance to completely escape this chess game spanning ten thousand worlds?"

The Void fell silent for a moment. The Destiny Scribe's voice sounded again, carrying an ungraspable emotion: "The third path is to merge three into one. The Tianji Record, the Destiny Scribe, and the Heavenly Secrets Eye are originally three fragments of your divine soul. Through ten thousand worlds of reincarnation, you separated, sealed, and forgot them one by one—and now you need to reclaim them all to truly break the deadly game set by heaven. But before that..."

"Before that, you need to find Chen Nian. She is the key—the key to unlocking the true power of the Heavenly Secrets Eye." The Destiny Scribe's voice abruptly deepened. "But be careful, the Heavenly Secrets Eye... it has already sensed you." Before the words even finished, Chen Ji felt an intense pain in his brow center, as if the Heavenly Secrets Eye that had just cracked open was forcefully suppressed, falling into silence once more.

A violent tremor came from the depths of the Mental Sea—that was the sign of the Destiny Scribe retreating. "All I can tell you is this much." Its voice grew more distant, more blurred. "The road ahead requires you to walk it yourself. Remember—Chen Nian is the key, the Heavenly Secrets Eye is the lock, and you... are the only one who can open this lock. The layout spanning ten thousand worlds is finally about to reach its final chapter."

The golden light completely vanished, and everything returned to darkness and silence. Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes, finding himself still standing in the ruins of Tianqing Sect, as if nothing had happened. But the burning mark deep in his Mental Sea told him—everything had already changed. His past life, his present, his Heavenly Fate, even the usage of the Tianji Record—all were completely overturned in this single moment.

Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at his own hands. Three faintly visible runes appeared on his palms—the marks of the Tianji Record, the Destiny Scribe, and the Heavenly Secrets Eye—now slowly seeping into his flesh and blood at an extremely slow pace. Ten thousand worlds of reincarnation, seven thousand years of searching, and the answer was finally revealed: he was not a chess piece, was never a chess piece—he was the Chess Player who personally tore apart his divine soul, then forgot his own face.

"Chen Nian..." Chen Ji murmured, an image of his sister's blurred face surfacing in his mind. Heavenly Fate's key, the Destiny Scribe said she was the key to everything. The Holy Sect took her away and used her to threaten him—and now he finally understood, that was not merely a threat, but the final move in heaven's chess game. It intended to use Chen Nian to restrain him, to bind him with familial affection, preventing him from ever truly breaking free from this ten-thousand-world chess game.

A fierce killing intent flickered in Chen Ji's eyes, then was forcefully suppressed. He took a deep breath, surveying his surroundings—the ruins of Tianqing Sect appeared especially desolate in the night, with broken halls, collapsed stone pillars, and the bodies of disciples who had survived the war. Everything had not yet ended, he told himself. Even knowing the truth, the chess game continued, and he—the seventh Chess Player—must re-enter the game.

"Tianqing Sect..." Chen Ji said quietly, his voice carrying a complex emotion. The old Sect Master Ling Yuan still lurked in the shadows, watching covetously; Han Lie from Xuanwu Sect stirred restlessly; the forces of the Holy Sect on the Demonic Path were deeply entrenched; and the distant Chen Nian was being held as a chess piece. These opponents, these schemes, this chaos—before, he thought he was secretly laying out a game, but now he understood, he was merely following heaven's script.

But now it is different. Chen Ji slowly raised his head, his gaze penetrating the heavy night curtain, as if gazing toward that intangible will high above the nine heavens. Ten thousand worlds of reincarnation did not make him yield; instead, they forged him into something sharper. Heaven wants him to be a chess piece? Fine, then let this chess piece devour the Chess Player. Heaven wants him to forget? Fine, then let this forgetting become the sharpest blade.

Chen Ji turned and walked toward the darkness. His figure appeared especially lonely among the ruins, yet carried an alarming resolve. The secrets spanning ten thousand worlds have been unveiled, and his path of revenge has just begun. The Heavenly Secrets Eye burned faintly at his brow center, as if warning of something—or perhaps anticipating something. And deep within the Holy Sect, the distant Chen Nian, as if sensing something, murmured in her sleep: "Brother..."
